# Real release fixture — pos_machine 01d17de

Generated on the local host, without devices or production. The generator is
tool/generate_launch_p0_release_fixture.dart in this repository. Export the
unmodified release with git archive 01d17de into a disposable directory,
copy only that generator to test/generate_launch_p0_release_fixture_test.dart,
resolve the release's local Flutter package dependencies, and run:

    $env:P0_RELEASE_OUTPUT = '<absolute path to this fixture directory>'
    dart <flutter_tools.snapshot> test --no-pub test/generate_launch_p0_release_fixture_test.dart

This round used .fix2-release-export and the installed C:/src/flutter runtime.
The release lib/ source was not edited. The generator invokes release session,
outbox, held-order and table writers; payloads.json is their emitted wire output.
It creates two unsent cashier comp/gift sales (cashier 7), one held bill and one
table event, preserving their generated IDs in expected.json. No cashier role,
staff position or merchant preference is changed to obtain a green result.
The token release-fixture-token substitutes the secure-storage platform boundary;
it is not a real credential. No device_uuid preference is supplied.

t3/ is a byte-identical copy of all six supplied files from
D:/launch-work/p0fix1/t3-release-storage-01d17de/. provenance.json records their
SHA-256 values. prefs.json is parsed from FlutterSharedPreferences.xml with only
the standard flutter. prefix removed. generated/ starts with these database
files; the release writers append the exercise records. Original T3 records
remain present. card-pay.json is emitted by the release standalone QR-pay
builder. Bank results in candidate tests replace only the external terminal
boundary because the supplied T3 copy contains no terminal PIN.

manifest.json hashes the complete captured fixture. To regenerate, use a new
destination; IDs and times are generated by the release, so new hashes differ.
Candidate tests copy these files to a unique temporary directory before opening
them; never run the candidate against the canonical fixture files.
